changelog: - **Configurable password policy + breached-password screening** (#1544, fixes #1215 for good). The rule a new password is judged by is now data — `passwordMinLength` (clamped 8…128 on read, refused outside that range on write), `passwordRequireUpper/Lower/Digit/Symbol`, `breachedPasswordCheck` — read through the per-org settings chain; defaults equal the old hard-coded rule. `src/lib/passwordPolicyRule.ts` holds the pure, Unicode-aware check (unit-tested) shared by the server (`checkPassword()` in `src/lib/password.ts`, the one entry point for register, reset and account; refusals answer `400 { code: 'password_policy', failed }` / `'password_breached'`) and the browser (`GET /api/auth/password-policy`, `usePasswordPolicy()`, `<PasswordRules>` under every new-password field), so the forms validate exactly what the API enforces. `src/lib/breachedPassword.ts` screens against Have I Been Pwned by k-anonymity — five hex characters of the SHA-1 leave the box, the suffix is matched locally, `Add-Padding` on — through the SSRF guard with a 2 s timeout and **fails open** with one logged warning. Controls on `/admin/settings` next to the 2FA policy (EN/TR/DE). `e2e/password-policy.spec.ts` against a local HIBP stub (`e2e/support/hibp-mock.mjs`); the server contract is `@smoke`. `docs/password-policy.md`.

en: Organizations can now set their own password rules — minimum length, upper/lower case, digit, symbol — and the sign-up, reset and account forms show and check exactly those rules as you type. New passwords are also screened against known data breaches (Have I Been Pwned, privacy-preserving: only a five-character fingerprint leaves the server), and an outage of that service never blocks you.
tr: Kuruluşlar artık kendi parola kurallarını belirleyebiliyor — en az uzunluk, büyük/küçük harf, rakam, sembol — ve kayıt, sıfırlama ve hesap formları siz yazarken tam olarak bu kuralları gösterip denetliyor. Yeni parolalar ayrıca bilinen veri sızıntılarına karşı taranıyor (Have I Been Pwned, gizliliği koruyarak: sunucudan yalnızca beş karakterlik bir parmak izi çıkıyor); bu servisin kesintisi sizi asla engellemiyor.
de: Organisationen können jetzt eigene Passwortregeln festlegen — Mindestlänge, Groß-/Kleinbuchstaben, Ziffer, Sonderzeichen — und die Formulare für Registrierung, Zurücksetzen und Konto zeigen und prüfen beim Tippen genau diese Regeln. Neue Passwörter werden außerdem gegen bekannte Datenlecks geprüft (Have I Been Pwned, datenschutzfreundlich: nur ein fünfstelliger Fingerabdruck verlässt den Server); ein Ausfall dieses Dienstes blockiert nie.
